snippet.title: Rivage World Premiere & Announcement Trailer | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
Rivage is an atmospheric sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. research station, caught in a space phenomenon, physics defy logic, and reality breaks apart. Uncover the fate of the missing crew and piece together the mysteries onboard. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4094660/

Step into the 25th century and explore a beautifully haunting world while researching planet VESTA. Solve loop–based puzzles, decode logs from the lost crew, and use the K9 System to carry knowledge forward with each reset.

Created by Exnilo Studio and published in partnership with Raw Fury, Rivage blends mystery, emotional storytelling, and cosmic discovery.

Welcome aboard mysterious A.R.E.S. - join the community to piece Miranda’s captivating story together, and get immersed into the adventure fueled by mind bending unknowns.

Your mind is the key.
